pages.title: SnakeArea.io
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
SnakeArea.io is a snake survival game about growing large enough to take on stronger rivals. Begin as a small snake, move around the arena, and devour opponents to increase your size. Choose your encounters carefully as you work toward challenging the more powerful snakes.

Collect gold to improve speed, ferocity, and stamina. Trophies unlock additional stages, with ten stages to conquer and stronger opponents appearing as you advance. Your immediate goal is to grow, while the upgrades and stage progression provide longer-term targets beyond the next encounter.

pages.title: Sinkhole Rush
pages.creator: EKO FLOW D.O.O.
pages.description: Grow a sinkhole by swallowing objects around the city in Sinkhole Rush. Move from smaller targets to entire buildings, or enter Battle mode to face seven other holes in a two-minute round.

pages.title: Stick Fix: Matchstick Puzzle
pages.creator: LazarGames
pages.description: Move one or two matches to repair a wrong equation in Stick Fix: Matchstick Puzzle. Look for digits or operators you can change until both sides of the equation agree.

pages.title: Mellow Escape
pages.creator: Play Mirror Games
pages.description: Guide a blue block through the puzzles in Mellow Escape. Plan a route past the obstacles, pick up stars along the way and unlock different skins and themes as you go.

pages.title: Car Parking Simulator
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Steer into designated spaces in Car Parking Simulator. Switch between parking challenges and practice modes to get a feel for the vehicle before taking on tighter setups.

pages.title: Color Conquest: Territory War
pages.creator: bastikogame
pages.description: Command one of four factions in Color Conquest: Territory War. Capture more territory to grow your army, then use your faction's strengths to attack and destroy the opposing bases.

pages.title: Noob Village Tower Defense
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Defend a village from monsters coming through a portal in Noob Village Tower Defense. Move through the 2D platforms and keep the defenses working as fresh waves appear.

pages.title: HOTGEAR
pages.creator: LUCKY TRY
pages.description: Build a car to suit your style in HOTGEAR, then take it out into a pursuit. Watch the road for openings and see how well your setup handles at speed.

pages.title: Color Sand Puzzle
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Place colored sand pieces on the grid in Color Sand Puzzle. Bring enough matching color together to clear space and think about where the next shape could fit.

pages.title: Zenith Rush
pages.creator: Mateq
pages.description: Switch lanes to reach upgrades and beat the track time in Zenith Rush. Buy faster cars or improve the one you have so you can make it farther along the road.

pages.title: Farm Business Saga
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Plant crops and care for animals in Farm Business Saga. Trade what your farm produces, use the proceeds to expand it, and customize the property as the business grows.

pages.title: Steam Sorter
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Guide a robot through a steampunk workspace in Steam Sorter. Sort industrial waste as it comes through, or share the job with a second player using separate keyboard controls.

pages.title: Poppy Strike 5
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Search a haunted toy factory for a way out in Poppy Strike 5. Switch between weapons as you fight Huggy Wuggy and Kissy Missy through its empty corridors.

pages.title: Pops Quest
pages.creator: Liminal Creations Pvt. Ltd.
pages.description: Jump past obstacles and fight your way through Pop's Quest. Follow the father on a story-driven rescue, using your moves to get through the platforming challenges between him and his child.

pages.title: Fish Kingdom
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Try different activities under the sea in Fish Kingdom. Dress a mermaid, treat fish that need a doctor, or look for hidden objects in scenes full of sea life.

pages.title: World Flags Trivia
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Identify each flag from three choices in World Flags Trivia. Work through 194 questions, using colors, emblems and patterns to tell similar national flags apart.

pages.title: Christmas Candy Escape 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Slide to guide the candy's descent in Christmas Candy Escape 3D. Look for an open route down through each arrangement and avoid anything that can block the fall.

pages.title: Cosmo Puzzle
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Rotate and swap pieces to restore pictures in Cosmo Puzzle. Use a hint when you're stuck and help the robot build its collection of minerals from around the Solar System.

pages.title: Cat Challenge
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Cut ropes to bring a colorful candy disc to the waiting cat in Cat Challenge. Think through how the candy will swing or fall before you choose where to cut.

pages.title: Huggy Wuggy Escape
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Find a gun and ammunition in Huggy Wuggy Escape. Take down Huggy Wuggy, then make it out of the toy factory before the building explodes.

pages.title: Mining Rush 3D Underwater
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Hire miners and build up an underwater operation in Mining Rush 3D Underwater. Put the profits back into the crew so you can dig faster and earn more from the site.

pages.title: Wood Block Puzzle
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Place wooden shapes on the board in Wood Block Puzzle. Clear space by completing lines and leave enough room for awkward shapes as you try to beat your best score.

pages.title: Robot Evolution
pages.creator: Eugen Chepurniy
pages.description: Explore an underground facility in Robot Evolution. Fight robots as you move through the pixel-art caves and solve the puzzles that block the next part of the route.

pages.title: Mini Monkey Mart
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Grow bananas and stock the counter in Mini Monkey Mart. Keep supplies ready for the monkey customers and build up the grocery store as more shoppers arrive.

pages.title: Hamster Escape Jailbreak
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Help a hamster escape prison and get back to its family in Hamster Escape Jailbreak. Work through puzzles and movement challenges as you look for the next way out.

pages.title: Stickman Planks Fall
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Race a pack of stick figures in Stickman Planks Fall. Gather planks to bridge gaps and choose where to leave the main route without falling behind or dropping into the water.

pages.title: Pokikex. The Infinite Parasite
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Steer a hungry caterpillar through Grandpa Joseph's garden in Pokikex. The Infinite Parasite. Gobble up what you pass as you guide Pokikex through the plants with the keyboard or mouse.

pages.title: Linkz!
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Move coins into matching groups in Linkz! Study the triangular layout and work out how to bring pieces of the same color together as the board changes.

pages.title: LIGHT IN THE DARK
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Guide Qualfy past traps and enemies in LIGHT IN THE DARK. Reach the spirit of light held by the sorcerer Notruw and help bring light back to the forest.

pages.title: Water Sorting Puzzle
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Pour liquid between glasses in Water Sorting Puzzle. Use open space in the glasses to separate mixed layers and keep moving colors until each one has its own container.

pages.title: Zombie Last Castle 2
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Hold the castle against stronger zombie waves in Zombie Last Castle 2. Defend it alone or share the work with up to two other players as more attackers arrive.

pages.title: Captain Sniper
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Identify the targets in Captain Sniper and take a precise shot before they can harm civilians. Watch the scene through your scope and make sure you have the right person in sight.

pages.title: My Manga Avatar
pages.creator: Top Girl Games
pages.description: Create a custom manga character in My Manga Avatar. Try different shapes and colors for the facial features and adjust the overall look until the avatar feels like your own.

pages.title: Street Basketball
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Take 25 free throws in one minute in Street Basketball. Pick your player and give striped balls extra attention, since making a basket with one is worth two points.

pages.title: Super Stickman Fight
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fight other stick figures through hazardous levels in Super Stickman Fight. Use your fighter's movements to land blows and keep clear of dangers around the arena.

pages.title: Baby Adopter
pages.creator: x2line
pages.description: Care for a virtual baby in Baby Adopter. Feed and dress the child, then earn points through daily care, egg hunts and minigames as you explore the nursery.

pages.title: Rail Slide
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Collect pieces to lengthen your pole in Rail Slide. Keep enough of it intact to slide along the rails, and use the coins you collect to unlock other characters.

pages.title: Splash Colors
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Fire colored balls at falling bubbles in Splash Colors. Read the colored trail behind each bubble and choose a shot of the same color before it reaches the bottom.

pages.title: Happy Glass Puzzles 3
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Draw a channel for the water in Happy Glass Puzzles 3. Guide the flow into the glass and reach the fill line without losing too much water along the way.

pages.title: Playing Cards Memory
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Flip playing cards and remember where you saw each one in Playing Cards Memory. Find matching pairs and use what you learn from missed guesses to clear the board.

pages.title: Aztec Cubes Treasure
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Stack falling shapes in Aztec Cubes Treasure. Move each piece into an opening and build complete rows to make room for the blocks still coming down.

pages.title: Summer Cold Drinks Card Memory
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Turn over cards to find pairs of cold drinks in Summer Cold Drinks Card Memory. Keep their positions in mind and clear each larger board before time runs out.

pages.title: Beach Cocktails Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Match pairs of cocktail pictures in Beach Cocktails Memory. Remember the images you reveal and work quickly enough to remove every pair before the countdown ends.

pages.title: Real Impossible Chain Car Race 2020
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Drive while chained to another car in Real Impossible Chain Car Race 2020. Match your speed and turns to the other vehicle to reach the finish without breaking the chain.

pages.title: AXE Throw
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Throw an axe at the target in AXE Throw. Line up each attempt and pay attention to where the axe lands so you can adjust the next throw.

pages.title: Fishing Frenzy
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Cast for fish and treasure in Fishing Frenzy. Watch for sharks, use bombs when you need them, and look out for watches and other items among the catches.

pages.title: Moving Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Assemble pictures of movie trucks in Moving Trucks Jigsaw. Pick from twelve images and drag the pieces into position until each truck and its surroundings are complete.

pages.title: Castle Slot Machine
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Set the wager and active lines in Castle Slot Machine before spinning the reels. Check the symbols that land on those lines to see whether they form a winning combination.

pages.title: Dying Easter Eggs
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Dip eggs into different colors in Dying Easter Eggs. Try a different shade or style on each egg and build a collection of your own Easter designs.

pages.title: Destroy The Virus
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Help the sick people in Destroy The Virus by sending treatment their way. Watch for where it is needed and act quickly as more cases appear on the screen.

pages.title: Zipline Valley
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Draw a zipline across the valley in Zipline Valley. Route it away from hazards, then hold to send people down the line and guide them to the other side.

pages.title: Flappy Red Ball
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Keep a red ball afloat in Flappy Red Ball. Tap to change its height and steer through the openings in the obstacle course without letting the ball collide.

pages.title: Work Desk Difference
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Compare two versions of a workspace in Work Desk Difference. Look at the small details on and around the desk and select each change you find between the pictures.

pages.title: Opposite Photo Match
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Pick two photos that show opposites in Opposite Photo Match. Find four pairs to finish a level and try to do it within two minutes for a bonus.

pages.title: Kingdom Defence Alien Shooting
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Defend the kingdom from waves of aliens in Kingdom Defence Alien Shooting. Pick targets with the mouse and keep firing as each new group brings more attackers.

pages.title: PUBG vs Bots
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Choose one of five characters and two maps in PUBG vs Bots. Look for weapons around the area and use what you pick up to fight computer-controlled opponents.

pages.title: Tic Tac Toe Free
pages.creator: GamingStars
pages.description: Take turns marking the board in Tic Tac Toe Free. Try to get three in a line, block your opponent's threats, and choose between a friend and the computer.

pages.title: Lights
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Connect every bulb to the power source in Lights. Trace the wires and change the connections until all the bulbs light, then try to solve the next layout faster.

pages.title: Princess Cuffing Season
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Put together cold-weather outfits for a group of friends in Princess Cuffing Season. Browse their clothes and accessories and give each princess a style for the season.

pages.title: Mr Cube
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Jump from platform to platform in Mr Cube. Time your landings to keep going, and gather the cubes along the way to unlock different characters for future runs.

pages.title: Ninja Moves
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Aim a ninja's next move in slow motion in Ninja Moves. Hold while you line up the direction, then release to see how the leap plays out through the physics course.

pages.title: Flip Bottle
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Flip a bottle from one piece of furniture to another in Flip Bottle. Time single or double flips to reach tables, shelves and other objects as you travel through the rooms.

pages.title: Master Archery Shooting
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Hit both still and moving targets in Master Archery Shooting. Lead the moving targets and choose your shots carefully so you can hit them all with the arrows you have.

pages.title: Trickshot Arena
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Work out how to score from 22 different positions in Trickshot Arena. Check the angles and make each attempt count, since you have three balls for the challenge.

pages.title: Tennis Pro 3D
pages.creator: Dumadu Games Pvt Ltd
pages.description: Play from one end of a 3D court in Tennis Pro 3D. Move into position to meet the ball and work on timing your returns against the player across the net.

pages.title: Weapon.io
pages.creator: LoraStudio
pages.description: Fight other warriors as a hero from the Three Kingdoms in Weapon.io. Use speed bursts to move around opponents, time your attacks and upgrade your character as you play.

pages.title: Shishagon
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Work each numbered hexagon down to zero in Shishagon. Look at how the pieces affect one another and plan the order of your moves to clear the whole puzzle.

pages.title: Ludo Hero
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Roll the die and move your tokens around the board in Ludo Hero. Race the other players to get all your pieces to the center before anyone else.

pages.title: Twelve PGS
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Tap two matching numbers to merge them into a higher one in Twelve PGS. Look ahead to the combinations the new value opens and see whether you can reach twelve.

pages.title: Kings Card Decisions
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Rule a kingdom one card at a time in Kings Card Decisions. Swipe left or right to choose how to respond, and follow the results as you pursue quests and achievements.

pages.title: Ragdoll Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Move Kim out of a box in Ragdoll Challenge using the floppy character on screen. Experiment with the movement until you can get him down onto the floor.

pages.title: Mahjong Mahjong
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Remove matching pairs in Mahjong Mahjong to expose the tiles underneath them. Choose moves that reveal more pieces and work through the layout until the board is empty.

pages.title: Armagedon
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Fire at asteroids before they reach Earth in Armagedon. Watch the weapon's heat and pause between bursts when needed so it stays available for the next rocks.

pages.title: EG Hungry Chameleon
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Catch flies arriving from both sides in EG Hungry Chameleon. Move toward the next fly before time runs out and watch the chameleon change color as it eats.

pages.title: Bones Slasher
pages.creator: Game-Game.com.ua
pages.description: Guard the fortress in Bones Slasher as Vikings and skeletons attack. Pick where to strike with the mouse or touch controls and move your aim as new enemies approach.

pages.title: Pixel Driver
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take a free drive through town in Pixel Driver or see how quickly you can finish a time attack. Learn the streets and keep control of the car as you push for a faster run.

pages.title: Mask Lady Surgery
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Treat Marinette's injuries after a fight in Mask Lady Surgery. Follow the treatment steps to look after her wounds, then choose fresh clothes once the visit is finished.

pages.title: Santa Christmas Coloring
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Pick holiday drawings to color in Santa Christmas Coloring. Try your favorite shades on the festive scenes and work through the book one picture at a time.

pages.title: Girls Winter Fun
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Get two princesses ready to ski in Girls Winter Fun. Choose their ski clothes, hats, gloves and equipment so both are ready for a day on the mountain.

pages.title: Airplane Memory Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Flip tiles and find pairs of matching aircraft in Airplane Memory Challenge. Pick a difficulty level and remember where the planes are hidden as you work through the board.

pages.title: Tank Defender
pages.creator: c2gamesstudio
pages.description: Defend your position from aircraft in Tank Defender. Move your tank away from falling bombs and shoot back as you try to keep your territory safe for as long as possible.

pages.title: Girls Sale Rush
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Visit fashion shops with three princesses in Girls Sale Rush. Try different outfits on each girl and decide which pieces to buy after you've seen how they look.

pages.title: To the Sky!
pages.creator: More Awesome Games
pages.description: Launch high above the ground in To the Sky! Stay above the line to build your score, and plan your descent carefully so the landing keeps your run going.

pages.title: Flappy Dragon 2
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Fly a dragon through the landscape in Flappy Dragon 2. Adjust its height to avoid obstacles and gather gems as you try to go farther than your last flight.

pages.title: Fortune Puzzle
pages.creator: Duodezzzi
pages.description: Connect matching casino chips in Fortune Puzzle. Move them across the board and build chains of the same color as you work through the different puzzle layouts.

pages.title: Genius Memory
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Turn over cards and remember their positions in Genius Memory. Use what you saw on earlier turns to find the matching pictures and clear the pairs more quickly.

pages.title: Maze Monster
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Guide the monster through each maze to collect candy in Maze Monster. Trace a route around walls and see how quickly you can reach all the treats.

pages.title: Valentines Hidden Stars
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Search each Valentine scene for five hidden stars in Valentines Hidden Stars. Take your time inspecting the picture and find every star to move on to the next scene.

pages.title: Find The Candy Winter
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Look for stars and figure out how to reveal the treat in Find The Candy Winter. Explore the objects in each snowy scene to see which ones help solve the puzzle.

pages.title: The Little Cthulhu
pages.creator: EpicLords Studios
pages.description: Guide The Little Cthulhu back to R'lyeh before his father wakes. Dodge or destroy threats while flying through five worlds, then try the arcade mode as its difficulty rises.

pages.title: Sery Fashion Cover Dress Up
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Create a magazine-cover look in Sery Fashion Cover Dress Up. Open boxes to see the available clothes and accessories, then mix the pieces to put together an outfit for Sery.

pages.title: Trump Has Fallen
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Help Donald Trump defend the White House in Trump Has Fallen. Use the mouse to respond to opponents as they close in and try to hold your position.

pages.title: Mahjong Shanghai Dynasty
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Find pairs of identical tiles in Mahjong Shanghai Dynasty. Choose pieces with a free left or right side and look for removals that open up the remaining layout.
